quote: Case study: validation of Theorem 6 in a series environmental monitoring system. Three series sensors with Weibull baseline F_bar(x) = e^{-(lambda x)^beta}, lambda = 0.001, beta = 0.7; alpha = (1,1,1); additive-hazard vectors theta = (0.0008, 0.0010, 0.0012) and eta = (0.0005, 0.0010, 0.0015) with theta <=_w eta; AMH copula delta = 0.8 (phi log-convex); p = (0.92, 0.92, 0.92). Table 1 gives empirical CDFs: at t = 100, 300, 500, 700, F_hat_Y(t) = 0.1183, 0.4679, 0.7258, 0.8801 and F_hat_X(t) = 0.1251, 0.4823, 0.7405, 0.8912; F_X(t) >= F_Y(t) for all t, i.e. X <=st Y, confirming Theorem 6(a).
